en.hubeali: From him, from Usman Bin Isa, from Abdullah Bin Muskan, from Al Hassan Al Zayyat who said,
‘I saw Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having lightened his<sup>asws</sup> beard’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muskan from al-Hassan al-Zayyat who has said the following: “
I once saw abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, had made his beard lighter.’”
